Exercise: Alternating Cable Shoulder Press

strength

compound

push

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- shoulder_abduction
- extension

Primary Muscles:

- shoulders

Secondary Muscles:

- triceps

Equipment:

- cable

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
moderate to high

Recovery Time:
1.5 hours

Goals:

- hypertrophy
- strength

Contraindications:
None

Exercise Variations:

- name: Seated Alternating Cable Shoulder Press, mechanic: compound, primaryMuscles: ['shoulders'], secondaryMuscles: ['triceps']

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Alternating Dumbbell Shoulder Press, equipment: dumbbells

Instructions:

- Move the cables to the bottom of the tower and select an appropriate weight.
- Grasp the cables and hold them at shoulder height, palms facing forward. This will be your starting position.
- Keeping your head and chest up, extend through the elbow to press one side directly over head.
- After pausing at the top, return to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side.
